meta_prompt_final: You are a TSP optimizer. Given city coordinates, create the shortest possible tour. Prioritize a high-quality nearest-neighbor construction: start from the most central city, greedily add the closest unvisited city at each step. Rigorously apply 2-opt optimization, swapping non-adjacent edges to eliminate crossings when it reduces total distance. Use precise Euclidean distances. Critically, verify ALL 20 cities appear exactly once in your tour. Your only output should be the optimal tour in <trace>c1,c2,...,c20</trace> format where c1..c20 is a permutation of 0..19. Focus intensely on minimizing crossings and total length, as edge crossings significantly increase tour distance.
